component.name: Dropbox for Dolphin
component.summary: Browse Dropbox as dropbox:/ in Dolphin and other KDE applications

description.p: A KIO worker that makes a Dropbox account browsable at dropbox:/ in Dolphin, in file dialogs, and in every other KDE application. It talks to the Dropbox HTTP API directly, so no proprietary client runs and nothing is synchronized to disk: folders are listed on demand and files are streamed as they are opened.

ul.li: Browse, read, write, rename and delete, straight from the file manager
Moves and copies within Dropbox happen server-side, transferring no data
Large uploads stream through chunked upload sessions
Free space is reported in Dolphin's status bar
A Dropbox entry in the file manager sidebar, which you can turn off
Account setup in System Settings, under Network

description.p: Sign-in uses OAuth with PKCE. The long-lived token is kept in KWallet, never in plain text unless no wallet is available, and the short-lived access token lives only in the runtime directory.
